theorems.name: Submission.varifold_tangents_rh_measure_homogeneous
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (s : ℝ), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ → 0 < s → (∀ g : Euclidean N → ℝ, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → ∫ y, g (s⁻¹ • y) ∂μ = s ^ n * ∫ y, g y ∂μ) → ∀ A : Set (Euclidean N), μ (s • A) = ENNReal.ofReal s ^ n * μ A
